optional_libraries.name: cuBLASLt
optional_libraries.feature: CUDA vision towers (--vision) and CUDA cuBLASLt projections
optional_libraries.install: install the NVIDIA CUDA 13 cuBLAS runtime; on Linux, add its directory to LD_LIBRARY_PATH; a driver-only host does not include it

optional_libraries.name: cuBLAS
optional_libraries.feature: Drama CUDA prompt and codec GEMMs
optional_libraries.install: install the NVIDIA CUDA 13 cuBLAS runtime; on Linux, add its directory to LD_LIBRARY_PATH

optional_libraries.name: rocBLAS
optional_libraries.feature: HIP BF16 dense projections and image towers
optional_libraries.install: install the rocBLAS runtime matching the ROCm installation; on Linux, add its directory to LD_LIBRARY_PATH

optional_libraries.name: hipBLASLt
optional_libraries.feature: HIP BF16 projections with a fixed decode algorithm
optional_libraries.install: install the hipBLASLt runtime matching the ROCm installation; on Linux, add its directory to LD_LIBRARY_PATH

optional_libraries.name: MIOpen
optional_libraries.install: install the MIOpen runtime matching the ROCm installation; on Linux, add its directory to LD_LIBRARY_PATH

optional_libraries.name: AOTriton
optional_libraries.install: install AOTriton 0.11.1 with its matching aotriton.images directory and set TENSORFOLD_AOTRITON to its library

optional_libraries.name: NCCL
optional_libraries.install: install the NVIDIA NCCL 2 runtime compatible with CUDA 13; on Linux, add its directory to LD_LIBRARY_PATH

optional_libraries.name: RDMA verbs
optional_libraries.install: install rdma-core's libibverbs runtime and the provider for the network adapter

optional_libraries.name: TensorFold video
optional_libraries.install: build the optional zig build video -Dffmpeg=PREFIX runtime against FFmpeg 9.0.2 and place it in lib beside the server; see packaging/RUNTIME.md

optional_libraries.name: libjpeg-turbo
optional_libraries.install: install libjpeg-turbo 3.1.4.1 and set TENSORFOLD_LIBTURBOJPEG to its file, or put it on the documented loader path

optional_libraries.name: libwebp
optional_libraries.install: install libwebp 1.6.0 and set TENSORFOLD_LIBWEBP to its decoder file, or put it on the documented loader path

optional_libraries.name: TensorFold grammar
optional_libraries.feature: structured output and required tool calls (HTTP 400 when missing)
optional_libraries.install: restore the matching release archive's lib/ directory or run zig build grammar -Dxgrammar=DIR; prepare DIR with git clone --branch v0.2.8 --recurse-submodules https://github.com/mlc-ai/xgrammar

optional_libraries.name: RCCL
optional_libraries.install: install the RCCL runtime matching the ROCm installation; on Linux, add its directory to LD_LIBRARY_PATH

optional_libraries.name: MCDMA RPC
optional_libraries.feature: MCDMA mailbox and Metal speed-up communication
optional_libraries.install: build and install MCDMA's RPC helper and set MCDMA_RPC_LIBRARY to its file

optional_libraries.name: MCDMA fabric
optional_libraries.install: build MCDMA's fabric helper and name its inspected absolute path in the peer settings
